entities.summary: Arnoldas Kulboka is a Lithuanian professional basketball player for Aris of the Greek Basketball League. He was selected by the Charlotte Hornets with the 55th overall pick in the 2018 NBA draft. At 2.06 m, he can play at both forward positions.
